rendering.originalAdvance: At most one frame per UpdateOffSet call, then next=CMain.Time+250; no elapsed-time catch-up. Index getter is base+OffSet; effect uses same Index+560.

select.fadeCaveat: MirControl starts Opacity=1; FadeIn setter does not reset it and SelectScene does not set Opacity. In this local source the configured fade saturates on its first update, so a visible fade-in is not established.

rendering.scale: Natural ChrSel width/height, one source pixel per logical UI pixel. No separate body/effect scale in the inspected preview renderers.
rendering.placement: For each frame independently: topLeft=unoffsetPreviewAnchor+(frame.x,frame.y). Do not add body offset to effect offset.

blend.wizardEffect: DXManager.SetBlend(true) NORMAL: source=SourceAlpha, destination=One, operation=Add, rate=1

rendering.clipping: No preview-child or modal-inner scissor in inspected Crystal Draw/DrawChildControls/DrawBlend; off-screen bounds checks and framebuffer clipping remain. Effect must not be clipped to body rectangle.

findings.confidence: confirmed source/pixel discrepancy in the originally observed renderer
findings.text: Original ordinary ImageNode on the effect layer overwrites weapon pixels with opaque dark effect RGB. Crystal requires additive SourceAlpha+One. Parent is separately implementing the shared renderer fix.
All 192 native metadata and exported PNG frames exactly match the original library dimensions, offsets, and decoded RGBA; changing sprite offsets or rebuilding art is not supported by this evidence.

findings.confidence: confirmed source behavior, not live tested here
findings.text: native_shell_ui render_shell_ui rebuilds all content on any model/focus change, so name typing/focus recreates preview frame0/timer. Crystal TextChanged only validates name/button; its existing MirAnimatedControl and OffSet remain alive.
Native Timer consumes times_finished_this_tick; Crystal advances only once and schedules now+250. Nominal cadence agrees; behavior after long stalls differs.
All five classes and both genders have audited assets; current native creation picker exposes only Warrior/Wizard/Taoist. Assassin/Archer audit does not enable them or claim gameplay acceptance.

Native preview_data comment says all non-Wizard +560 ranges are transparent, but several 4x1 frames contain a single [144,40,0,255] pixel at offset(15,109). Selection original unconditionally adds these, producing a one-pixel color at logical(275,529). Creation only invokes Wizard so these are irrelevant there. No extra full character effects or wrong body frames were found.
